Kelce made his way onto the field at Raymond James Stadium just as Taylor Swift’s “Blank Space” came over the speakers. The song is reportedly Travis’ favorite track, making the timing even more interesting. They say coincidences don’t exist, so some fans are already taking it as an omen for what could be a big season for Kelce — especially with rumors suggesting this could be his final one. Whether it means anything remains to be seen, but the timing certainly got people talking.
